name: Nord Precious Metals Mining Inc.
summary: Nord Precious Metals Mining Inc. operates as an exploration enterprise focused on identifying, appraising, investigating, and ultimately developing mineral properties. Its current portfolio of projects includes Castle East, Eby-Otto, Graal, Castle Mine, Beaver Mine, and Violet Mine. Jennifer L. Boyle and Pamela D. Strand established the company on April 29, 2005, and its main corporate offices are situated in Coquitlam, Canada.
